keywords.func: Define a function. Use `func name(args) { ... }` or `func name => command`.
keywords.var: Declare a variable. Reference it later as `$name`.
keywords.alloc: Allocate a native buffer into a variable by byte count or interop type size.
keywords.class: Define a ToSh class with properties, constructors, and methods.
keywords.module: Define a named ToSh module object with its own lexical scope.
keywords.enum: Define a named enum with symbolic members and optional underlying numeric storage.
keywords.record: Define a named data shape with positional construction, defaults, and structural equality.
keywords.prop: Declare a class property, getter, setter, or computed member.
keywords.shy: Keep a declaration in the current lexical scope, or hide a class member from public inspection and external access.
keywords.static: Mark a class member as belonging to the class instead of an instance.
keywords.global: Publish a declaration to the session-wide scope.
keywords.export: Export a module declaration or environment variable.
keywords.using: Import CLR namespaces or create CLR aliases in the current lexical scope.
keywords.require: Load a `.tosh` module, `.dll`, or `.csproj` once per session and import names lexically.
keywords.native: In `require native`, load a native shared library for binding and invocation.
keywords.bind: Attach native function bindings to a required native module.
keywords.from: Select a source file or module in selective `require` forms.
keywords.as: Rename a CLR alias or required export in the current scope.
keywords.out: Mark a native binding parameter as output-only and return its updated value after the call.
keywords.ref: Mark a native binding parameter as by-reference so the call can read and update it.
keywords.callconv: Override the native calling convention for a bound export.
keywords.if: Run a block when a condition evaluates to true.
keywords.for: Iterate over pipeline output or another enumerable source.
keywords.while: Repeat a block while a condition remains true.
keywords.until: Repeat a block until a condition becomes true.
keywords.return: Exit the current function or script early.
keywords.catch: Handle a thrown value or runtime failure.
keywords.switch: Legacy statement-style value matching with `case` blocks.
keywords.match: Use `match (<value>) { pattern => result; default => fallback }` for expression-style branching, or `match <regex> ...` as the regex command.
keywords.continue: Skip the rest of the current loop iteration.
keywords.new: Construct a CLR object, ToSh named type, or shell collection type like `new list<String>(...)`.
keywords.nameof: Return the name of a variable or member path.

specialVariables.$tosh: The live ToSh runtime namespace root for config, script state, shell/session state, and host metadata.
specialVariables._: The current pipeline item in `where`, `each`, and similar contexts.

builtins.exec: Replace the current ToSh process with an external command such as `tosh`, `zsh`, or `/bin/sh`.
builtins.where: Filter pipeline objects with a predicate expression.
builtins.each: Iterate a pipeline and transform or emit values from a block.
builtins.get: Project one or more properties from each object.
builtins.sort: Sort pipeline values by whole value or property.
builtins.group-by: Group values by a property or expression.
builtins.flatten: Explicitly expand lists and arrays into pipeline items.
builtins.summarize: Compute structured aggregate summaries over the current pipeline and return ColumnSummary objects only.
builtins.glob: Expand filesystem glob patterns into filesystem objects.
builtins.grep: Search text with .NET regular expressions or fixed-string mode.
builtins.first: Take the first item or first N items.
builtins.last: Take the last item or last N items.
builtins.take-while: Take items while a predicate remains true.
builtins.skip-while: Skip items while a predicate remains true.
builtins.tee: Pass values through while capturing them elsewhere.
builtins.help: Show help for commands, language topics, and CLR types.
builtins.ip: Return typed network interface objects for `ip addr`, and fall back to the system utility for other subcommands.
builtins.systemctl: Return typed systemd unit rows for supported `list-units` queries, typed unit-file rows for supported `list-unit-files` queries, and structured unit property sets for supported `show` and `status` queries.
builtins.journalctl: Stream typed journal-entry objects for supported JSON-backed `journalctl` query paths, and fall back to the native utility for unsupported modes.
builtins.loginctl: Return typed session, user, and seat rows for supported `loginctl` list queries, and structured property sets for supported `show-*` queries.
builtins.hostnamectl: Return a structured host-status object for supported JSON-backed `hostnamectl` status queries, and fall back to the native utility for mutating commands.
builtins.networkctl: Return typed network-link rows for supported `networkctl list` queries, and fall back to the native utility for detail and mutating commands.
builtins.lsblk: Return typed block-device objects for JSON-backed `lsblk` invocations, and fall back to the system utility for unsupported output modes.
builtins.lscpu: Return a typed CPU summary by default, or typed topology/cache rows for JSON-backed `lscpu -e` and `lscpu -C` invocations.
builtins.lsfd: Return typed open-file-descriptor rows for JSON-backed `lsfd` invocations, and typed summary counters for `--summary=only`.
builtins.lsipc: Return structured IPC resource rows or global IPC limit rows for JSON-backed `lsipc -J` invocations, and fall back to the system utility for unsupported text-only modes.
builtins.findmnt: Return typed mounted-filesystem objects for JSON-backed `findmnt` invocations, and fall back to the system utility for unsupported output modes.
builtins.inspect: Display CLR type and member information for objects.
builtins.describe-type: Describe a CLR type, ToSh named type, or shell collection type.
builtins.members: List members on a CLR type or object.
builtins.methods: List callable methods on a CLR type or object.
builtins.constructors: List constructors for CLR types, ToSh named types, and shell collection types.
builtins.types: Search available CLR and ToSh shell types.
builtins.load-assembly: Load a CLR assembly into the current session.
builtins.read-buffer: Read a cstring, bytes, or a native scalar/struct-layout value from native memory.
builtins.write-buffer: Write text, bytes, or a struct-layout value into native memory.
builtins.size-of: Return the unmanaged size of a native interop type.
builtins.offset-of: Return the unmanaged field offset for a struct-layout type.
builtins.cast: Convert values to a target CLR type, including constructed collection types like `list<int>`.
builtins.date: Create, parse, and manipulate dates and instants.
builtins.from-xml: Parse XML into CLR XML objects.
builtins.parse: Extract structured data from text using .NET regular expressions, including named groups and inline modifiers.
builtins.match: Extract regex matches from text. Use `match (<value>) { ... }` for the language expression form.
builtins.replace: Replace text literally or with .NET regular expressions via `-r`.
builtins.split: Split text by a literal delimiter or by .NET regex with `-r`.
builtins.as-file: Materialize values into a temporary file and return a file object.
builtins.jobs: List ToSh background jobs started with a trailing `&`.
builtins.wait-for: Wait for one or more background jobs to finish.
builtins.kill: Stop a ToSh background job or an operating-system process.
builtins.signal: Send a named or numeric signal to a ToSh job or process id.
builtins.config: Inspect, mutate, reset, or initialize ToSh runtime and startup configuration.
builtins.history: Show, search, expand, run, delete, save, reload, clear, or inspect the current shell history and its persisted history file.
builtins.export: Export an environment variable or publish a declaration.
builtins.find: Recursively search filesystem entries by path, glob name, or regex path filters.
builtins.read-file: Read one or more whole files as string values.
builtins.read-lines: Read one or more files line-by-line as ShellTextLine values.
builtins.write-file: Write plain text to a file, replacing previous contents.
builtins.append-file: Append plain text to a file, creating it when needed.
builtins.read-bytes: Read one or more files as byte arrays.
builtins.write-bytes: Write byte-oriented content to a file.
builtins.open-file: Open one or more files as managed text or binary handles.
builtins.close: Close one or more managed file handles.
builtins.read-from: Read a text or binary chunk from an open managed file handle.
builtins.read-line-from: Read the next text line from an open managed file handle.
builtins.read-to-end: Read the remainder of an open managed file handle.
builtins.write-to: Write plain text or bytes into an open managed file handle.
builtins.write-line-to: Write one or more text lines into an open managed text file handle.
builtins.flush: Flush one or more managed file handles.
builtins.seek: Move an open managed file handle to a new position.
builtins.position: Return the current stream position for one or more managed file handles.
builtins.length: Return the current stream length for one or more managed file handles.
builtins.copy-to: Copy the remaining contents of one managed file handle into another.
builtins.forget: Remove variables, functions, exported names, or free native buffers.
